## Who we are
This website is run by **IN-TA Solutions Private Limited** (CIN U62010KL2025PTC092951), whose registered office is at Peruli, Paingattiri, Kunnerikunnu, Nallurnad, Mananthavady, Wayanad 670645, Kerala, India. We decide what happens to the details you send us, so we're responsible for them under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000.

## What we collect
We only collect what you type into one of our forms:
- **The contact page and the order form on the Services page** ask for your name, email address, phone number, country and your message. With it we record the page you sent it from and your browser's user agent (the name and version of your browser and operating system).
- **The enquiry form near the end of most pages** (“Tell us what you'd like to fix”) asks for your name, business email, company, what you need and a line about the problem, and if you like, your WhatsApp number.
- **The chat with the robot in the corner of the screen** starts by asking for your name and a phone number or an email address. After that it keeps what you write to the robot and his answers, what he understood about your project, and the pages you looked at on our website. See “The robot's chat” below.
{tracking} It keeps a few small notes in your browser's own storage, which never leave your device: whether the opening animation has played and whether the robot has already greeted you, what he last said, his lines for the pages you've opened, the pages you've looked at and for how long (so he can talk about them), the details you gave him at the start of the chat (so it carries on from page to page until you close the tab), that you hid him, or your answer to our cookie prompt, if we showed you one. To see how the site is used, we count visits with Vercel Web Analytics: it records the page visited, the site you came from, your country and your type of device and browser, without cookies and without keeping your IP address, and we only ever see totals. We also count each time one of our forms is sent, without anything you typed into it.

## How we use it
We use your details to read your enquiry and get back to you about it. A message from the contact page or the Services page is saved in our database and emailed to our team, and a copy is emailed to you to confirm that it arrived. An enquiry from the enquiry form is saved in our database and emailed to our team. A chat with the robot is saved in our database too, and our team gets an email when one starts, so they can follow up with you.
We don't sell your details, share them for marketing, or add you to a mailing list.

## The robot's chat
**Your details stay with us.** The name, phone number and email address you give at the start of the chat go only to our own database, where our team sees them with the conversation. They are never sent to the AI: the robot calls you by your name, but our website adds it to his answers after they come back. A phone number or email address you type into the chat is held back from the AI in the same way.
**The robot's answers are written by Google's Gemini AI.** To answer you, our website sends Google what you write in the chat (without the details above), the earlier questions and answers in the same chat, the text of the page you're on, the pages you've looked at on our website this visit and for how long, and what our website already says about IN-TA.
We use Gemini's free service. Under its terms, Google may use what is sent and the answers to improve its products, and people at Google may read them. So **please don't type confidential details into the chat**.
Gemini also writes what the robot does and says on each page while you read it. For that, our website sends Google only the page's own text, never anything about you, and keeps his lines for each page for up to 12 hours so that one set serves every visitor.
**What we keep.** We save the chat in our database: your name and contact details, what you and the robot wrote, what he understood about your project (the service, what you need, your kind of business, when and your budget, if you said), and the pages you looked at. Our team uses it only to get back to you about your enquiry. To have it deleted, email {email}.
To stop the chat being misused, our website counts how many questions come from each IP address over the last day, in its memory only. The chat and Gemini's lines aren't offered in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, where Google's free service can't be used: our hosting provider tells our website which country a visit comes from, and that isn't stored either.

## How long we keep it
- Messages, enquiries and robot chats are deleted from our database automatically 24 months after they arrive (a chat, 24 months after its last message), and the emails our team received about them are deleted from our inbox on the same schedule.
- If an enquiry turns into work with us, we keep what that work needs for as long as our agreement with you and the law require.
- You can ask us to delete your details sooner at any time: see “Your rights” below.
- The notes in your browser's storage stay on your device. Most are gone when you close the tab, and you can clear the rest in your browser's settings.

## Services we use
The site runs on a few outside services, which handle your details only to run it for us:
- **Vercel** hosts this website and counts its visits as described above, and **Render** runs the system that receives the forms.
- **Neon** hosts the database where messages and robot chats are saved.
- **Cloudinary** stores and serves the images on the site.
- **An email service** delivers the emails described above.
- **Google's Gemini API** writes the robot's answers and his lines on each page, as described above.
- **Google Fonts** supplies the site's icons, so your browser asks Google's servers for them and Google sees your IP address.
Some of these services store or process data outside India.
Links to Google Maps, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube take you to those sites, and their own privacy policies apply there.

## Children
Our website and services are meant for businesses and adults. If you're under 18, please don't send us your details or chat with the robot. If we find out that we've received a child's details, we'll delete them.

## Your rights
Under India's data protection law, you can:
- ask for a summary of the personal details we hold about you, what we do with them and who we've shared them with;
- ask us to correct, complete, update or delete them;
- withdraw any consent you've given, as easily as you gave it;
- name someone to use these rights for you if you die or become unable to;
- complain to our Grievance Officer (below) and, if you're not satisfied with the answer, to the Data Protection Board of India.
To use any of them, email {email}. We may ask you to confirm that the request is really from you, and we reply within one month.

## Grievance Officer
For questions about your details, or a complaint about how we've handled them, write to our Grievance Officer:
- **Grievance Officer**, IN-TA Solutions Private Limited
- Email: {email}
- Post: Peruli, Paingattiri, Kunnerikunnu, Nallurnad, Mananthavady, Wayanad 670645, Kerala, India
We'll confirm that we've received your complaint and resolve it within one month.

## Changes to this policy
When this policy changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top. If a change affects something you've allowed, such as the Meta Pixel, we'll ask you again.

The document's {tracking}, while a Meta Pixel ID is filled in

With your permission, this website uses the Meta Pixel, a tool from Meta (the company behind Facebook and Instagram), so we can measure our Facebook and Instagram ads. It stays off until you choose **Allow** in the cookie prompt we show on your first visit, and it never runs for visits from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland. Once you allow it, Meta's script tells Meta which pages you open on our website and which buttons you tap there, your IP address and your browser and device, and sets cookies (such as _fbp) so it can recognise your browser on later visits; if you're logged in to Facebook or Instagram, Meta may link this to your account. We also tell Meta when one of our forms is sent, a chat with the robot starts, or you tap our WhatsApp, phone or email links, but never anything you typed. Meta uses this under its own privacy policy (https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy). We keep your answer to the prompt in your browser, and in our database with a random code, the date and the version of the prompt, so we can show what you agreed to; it says nothing about who you are. We ask again after a year. You can change your answer at any time under [Cookie settings](#cookie-settings) at the bottom of every page: choosing No thanks stops the Pixel and removes its cookies from our website. Apart from that, this website sets no cookies and uses no other advertising or tracking tools.

## How we protect your details
- The website and the system behind it only work over encrypted connections (HTTPS), and tell browsers never to use an unencrypted one.
- They run on established cloud services: Vercel hosts the website, Render runs the system that receives the forms, Neon hosts the database and Cloudinary stores the images.
- Only our team can sign in to the admin where messages, enquiries and robot chats are kept, and passwords are stored only in hashed form.
- Our forms and the robot's chat limit how many messages one visitor can send, to stop abuse.
- The robot's AI never receives the name, phone number or email address you give in the chat.
- We keep personal details only as long as our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) says, and then delete them.

## If something goes wrong
If we find out about a security breach that affects your personal details, we'll tell you and report it to the authorities, including CERT-In and the Data Protection Board of India, as Indian law requires.

## Report a vulnerability
If you think you've found a security weakness in our website or systems, please email {email} with what you found and how to reproduce it. Please don't access or change other people's data, disrupt the service, or make the problem public before we've had a reasonable time to fix it. We'll confirm that we've received your report and keep you updated.
